run_metadata.coverage_summary: Attempted the full source universe (Tier 1 core government, Tier 2 broader public sector / GBE, Tier 3 private). Direct page retrieval remained fully blocked again this run: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL tested, including the AusTender ATM list, and the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (recentRelayFailures empty). Per proxy policy, 403 org-policy denials were not retried or routed around, so no tender detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened directly; all capture is from WebSearch, cross-verified across multiple independent queries, with any item whose close date had already passed (or could not be corroborated) rejected. Two genuinely new currently-relevant opportunities were captured this run: (1) an ANSTO ILWCI+ Project (Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase) construction industry-briefing / upcoming-RFT notice on AusTender (PSC002897 - online briefing 31 Jul 2026, register interest by 4:00pm AEST 29 Jul 2026, RFT release intended early Aug 2026), recorded as a market-sounding notice with well-corroborated scope; and (2) a SA Water EOI to design and construct the Millicent Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) EIP Upgrade - the first competitive stage of a multi-stage D&C principal-contractor procurement run via SA Water's Supplier Portal (closing date not publicly recoverable this run). Five previously-seen opportunities were re-verified as still open and carried forward with their original first_seen dates: CSIRO RFT CSIRORFT2026019 Ground Maintenance VIC Metro (closes 17 Aug 2026), City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI (closes 10 Aug 2026), Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Pavement Rehab Stage 2 Culvert Unit Supply (closes 4 Aug 2026), DCCEEW ATM_2026_6786 GEMS verification-testing laboratory panel (re-confirmed this run as published 1 Jul 2026, closes 12 Aug 2026), and Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI (closes 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon). Two genuinely new buyer-originated sources were recorded: the new AusTender Supplier Portal (Department of Finance Central Procurement Systems - Phase 3 open supplier registration from July 2026) and SA Water's Supplier Portal (SA Water now runs its RFx through it). Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, and energy/construction majors) was checked as required: no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login, so no corporate tender was captured (portals remain registration-gated or invitation-only). Zero tenders, dates, deliverables or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: Direct page retrieval fully blocked again this run. WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external URL (including https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm); the agent-proxy status endpoint confirmed the org egress policy denies CONNECT to external hosts (recentRelayFailures empty). The proxy README instructs not to retry 403/407 policy denials. Consequence: no ATM/RFT/EOI detail page, listing page, RSS/API feed or specification document could be opened; all detail is limited to cross-verified WebSearch snippets. Source-document deliverables/requirements extraction was not possible this run.

SA Water Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade EOI: existence, buyer (SA Water), EOI nature and design-and-construct multi-stage scope were corroborated across two independent sources (australiantenders.com.au issuer listing #602099 and govmarket.com.au), and an SA Water news item confirms an active South East (Millicent/Mount Burr/Nangwarry) wastewater upgrade program. However the exact EOI reference, closing date/time, evaluation criteria and value are only visible inside SA Water's registration-gated Supplier Portal and could not be recovered behind the 403 wall - recorded at headline+scope level with closing_date null. NOTE the separately-reported ~$4m York Civil concrete-tank works at those plants are already under construction and are a DIFFERENT scope from this D&C EIP-upgrade EOI.

ANSTO ILWCI+ (PSC002897): this AusTender notice is an industry-briefing / early-RFT notice, not yet an open RFT. Briefing date (31 Jul 2026), interest-registration deadline (4:00pm AEST 29 Jul 2026), buyer (ANSTO, Lucas Heights) and scope are well corroborated from the notice snippet, but the exact RFT release date, tender reference and documents will only exist once the RFT is published (intended early Aug 2026). Recorded as procurement_type=market-sounding.

City of Sydney Christmas Trees & Decorations 2028-2032 design-concept EOI and Transport for NSW HW4 Log Creek Culvert Unit Supply: carried forward and still open, but exact tender reference numbers, evaluation criteria and documents remain unrecoverable behind the TenderLink / buy.nsw 403 walls (headline level).

Western Power Clean Energy Link PCMS EOI: carried forward, closing within days (EOI due 31 Jul 2026, closing-soon). Exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and value remain behind the registration-gated + 403-blocked Opportunities Hub.

Search snippets again recycled closed/stale items as if current (e.g. Sydney Water WS5192918179 Drinking Water Program EPCM EOI, closed Nov 2024/Jun 2025; Melbourne Water Greenvale Reservoir Long-Range CCTV EOI, closed 22 Aug 2024; AusTender PR10031930 RASS closed 6 May 2026; 10018162 Attorney-General's Dept closed 29 May 2026). These were date-checked and REJECTED, not recorded.

Tier-1 state/territory portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria/buyingfor.vic, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were reachable only as landing pages via search; individual open tenders generally could not be drilled into or date-verified behind the 403 wall, so apart from the carried-forward TfNSW HW4 Culvert package no new state-portal opportunity could be confirmed at a trustworthy level of detail this run.

Tier-3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network, plus BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, Santos, Coles, Woolworths, Qantas, banks, telcos, EstimateOne construction packages): checked as required. No publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; corporate opportunities remain registration-gated or invitation-only, so none were captured as tenders (no corporate entries fabricated).
recommended_seed_additions: AusTender Supplier Portal (https://www.tenders.gov.au) - Department of Finance 'Central Procurement Systems' program. Phase 3 opens supplier self-registration to all suppliers from July 2026, creating a searchable supplier database agencies can proactively browse. Buyer-originated Commonwealth channel worth registering for authenticated runs and watching for the shift from advertise-and-respond to proactive sourcing.

SA Water - Supplier Portal (https://www.sawater.com.au/business/tenders-and-contracts) - SA Water now runs its public RFx (RFT/EOI) through its own registration-gated Supplier Portal rather than Tenders SA; currently hosting the Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade D&C EOI. Register for an authenticated pass.

tenders.title: ANSTO Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project - Industry Briefing / Upcoming RFT
tenders.buyer: Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation (ANSTO)
tenders.description: AusTender notice inviting interested construction contractors to an online industry briefing ahead of the upcoming Request for Tender for the Intermediate Level Waste Capacity Increase (ILWCI+) Project at ANSTO's Lucas Heights campus. The Commonwealth intends to release the formal RFT via an open approach to market in early August 2026.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The future contractor will construct a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility within ANSTO's highly regulated nuclear operational environment - involving significant reinforced-concrete structures, specialist fabricated components, mechanical and electrical services, and integration of process systems, delivered to high standards of quality assurance, traceability, inspection and testing.
key_deliverables: Construction of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility at Lucas Heights
Significant reinforced-concrete structures
Specialist fabricated components
Mechanical and electrical services
Integration of process systems with high QA, traceability, inspection and testing
tenders.scope_of_work: Delivery of a new Intermediate Level Waste storage facility within ANSTO's operational nuclear precinct at Lucas Heights, NSW. The Commonwealth is seeking contractors with demonstrated capability delivering complex industrial, infrastructure, process, energy, manufacturing, defence or similarly regulated projects.
requirements: Demonstrated capability delivering complex industrial / infrastructure / process / energy / manufacturing / defence or similarly regulated projects
tenders.eligibility: Open to suitably qualified and experienced construction contractors; each organisation attending the briefing is limited to five (5) participants.
tenders.questions_due: 2026-07-29 4:00 PM AEST (deadline to register interest in the industry briefing)
tenders.briefing: Online industry briefing on 31 July 2026 regarding the upcoming ILWCI+ RFT; registration of interest required by 4:00 pm AEST on 29 July 2026, max 5 participants per organisation.
tenders.submission_method: Register interest for the industry briefing via the AusTender notice; formal RFT to follow via open approach to market on AusTender (intended early August 2026)
tenders.delivery_location: ANSTO Lucas Heights campus, New South Wales
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM PSC002897/Brief notice snippet, cross-verified across two independent searches; the AusTender detail page itself was 403-blocked to direct fetch this run.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender for open/upcoming ATMs closing/briefing in the coming weeks. Buyer-originated Commonwealth notice published by ANSTO on AusTender. Recorded per the prompt's scope for notices of upcoming procurement / industry briefings, flagged procurement_type=market-sounding.
tenders.notes: Not yet an open RFT (closing_date null). Briefing 31 Jul 2026; register interest by 4:00pm AEST 29 Jul 2026; formal RFT intended early Aug 2026. Scope well corroborated from the notice; exact RFT reference and documents will exist only once the RFT is published.

tenders.title: Expression of Interest - Millicent WWTP EIP Upgrade (Design and Construct)
tenders.category: Water / wastewater infrastructure - design and construct
tenders.description: SA Water invites suitably experienced and qualified organisations to submit an Expression of Interest to design and construct the Millicent Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) EIP Upgrade. The EOI is the first competitive stage of a multi-stage procurement process to select a design and construct principal contractor to deliver the works.
tenders.deliverables_summary: The successful respondent will ultimately design and construct the upgrade of SA Water's Millicent Wastewater Treatment Plant. This EOI stage is used to shortlist capable design-and-construct principal contractors for a subsequent tender stage.
key_deliverables: Design of the Millicent WWTP EIP upgrade works
Construction of the Millicent WWTP EIP upgrade works
Delivery as design-and-construct principal contractor
tenders.scope_of_work: Design and construct upgrade of the Millicent Wastewater Treatment Plant (Environment Improvement Program upgrade) in the South East of South Australia, procured as a multi-stage process beginning with this EOI shortlisting stage.
tenders.eligibility: Open EOI to suitably experienced and qualified design-and-construct organisations; first competitive stage of a multi-stage procurement.
tenders.submission_method: Respond via SA Water's Supplier Portal (registration required; see 'How to access SA Water's public requests for proposal')
tenders.delivery_location: Millicent, South East region, South Australia
tenders.detail_source: australiantenders.com.au issuer listing #602099 and govmarket.com.au tender page, cross-verified; SA Water news item ('Upgrades underway for SA Water's SE wastewater plants') confirms an active South East wastewater upgrade program. SA Water Supplier Portal detail was registration-gated + 403-blocked this run.
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of SA Water / SA GBE water opportunities. Buyer-originated GBE EOI now published through SA Water's own Supplier Portal (SA Water moved its RFx off Tenders SA). Existence and D&C multi-stage nature corroborated across two independent sources.
tenders.notes: Headline+scope level only. Closing date/time, exact EOI reference, evaluation criteria and value are inside the registration-gated Supplier Portal and were not recoverable behind the 403 wall (closing_date null). Distinct from the ~$4m York Civil concrete-tank works already under construction at Millicent/Mount Burr/Nangwarry.
